justifications.durability: The composed-review assertion at tests/test_composed_review_waits_for_a_roster_slot.py:162 and the launch-equality assertion at tests/test_a_queued_launch_never_classifies_the_fleet.py:188 redden on a production regression, but the date-fixture change itself is unguarded: re-hardcoding a fixed timestamp would pass on the day it was written and only fail later, so the one-year clock arm is recorded evidence rather than a test.
justifications.evidence: The recorded head arm reports 19 passed EXIT=0 at code revision cbcae1b912, the clock-ahead arm 19 passed EXIT=0, and the base arm 5 failed/14 passed EXIT=1 with the five ids the done_when names; the two later commits are docs-only so the code gate still covers head (logs/head.log, logs/head-clock-ahead.log, logs/base.log).
justifications.fit: The change matches the established idiom -- datetime.now(UTC).isoformat() is used in 96 test occurrences across tests/ -- and the added comments state the mechanism (why a live fixture is dated when the test runs).
justifications.goal_fidelity: The five tests named in the goal pass at head 17d3e9adb47d6f470831bfa6f9afb42b21413c5d and again with the clock advanced one year, so the admission fixtures no longer age past the lost-session window (tests/test_a_new_plan_review_is_a_first_attempt.py:61 derives LIVE_AT at import).
justifications.reuse: The diff adds no function, class or module; the only new definitions are module-level timestamp constants and a local reference_dispatch wrapper, so nothing duplicates a repository capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff (four test files and one evidence fragment) is inside the declared write paths; the fragment is named qwnw-admission-tests-do-not-age-out.html rather than the stale s45.html the plan text spells, matching the qwnw- fragment convention used throughout docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/.
